thread:
maria_support: Customer reports a partner gift link that used to auto-apply credits now fails at checkout. UI shows `PROMO_INVALID` and a generic 'expired' message even though dashboard shows the campaign active. Order id: ORD-44219.
kevin_billing: Sent the customer a manual credit while we triage — credit ID CR-98765. :white_check_mark:
maria_support: Thanks Kevin — customer confirmed credit received. They still want the root cause since this is a large partner campaign.
oli_repro: Poking the repro now. Can you paste the exact link they used and the request payload if you have it?
maria_support: Link: https://redwood.app/redeem/gift/gft-2026-03?uid=44219
maria_support: Customer-redacted payload: `{"campaign_code":"GFTSPRING","user_id":"u_44219","source":"partner:gftco"}`
oli_repro: Reproduced locally — when I POST to /v1/promos/redeem I get 422 with body:
```
{
  "status": 422,
  "error_code": "promo_inactive",
  "campaign_id": "gft-2026-03",
  "message": "Campaign not active for account tier or outside activation window"
}
```
oli_repro: Interesting — on the account object I see recent plan change metadata `plan_change_ts` = now - 2h.
oli_repro: Looks like the new plan-change gating added in last week's release marks promos ineligible for 24h after a plan change. That logic is in `promo_eligibility.check_grace_window`.
jess_product: Yup — we shipped a guard to prevent abuse during plan migrations, but forgot to exempt partner gift links that explicitly carry `source=partner`. Regression on our side.
jess_product: Plan: patch `check_grace_window` to allow `source: partner` and add a unit test. Will open INF-1234 and target the patch for next deploy.
sre-bot: deploy-candidate created for patch branch promo/grace-exempt-partner at build 4592; CI passed.
oli_repro: Quick mitigation for support: if `source=partner` we treat as pre-validated and allow redemption immediately. I'll add feature flag so we can toggle if anything goes sideways.
kevin_billing: For customers already affected, issue manual credits (CR-XXXXX) and log in case notes. I already did for ORD-44219.
maria_support: Customer happy with credit for now, asked for ETA on permanent fix.
jess_product: I'll aim for a hotfix deploy in the next 4 hours, then a follow-up backfill to ensure no campaign metrics are skewed. INF-1234 created and assigned to oli_repro.
oli_repro: After hotfix I'll run a quick smoke: partner gift link redemption, plan-change within 1h, and API double-submit edgecases.
maria_support: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the partner and close the loop once the patch is live. :pray:
kevin_billing: Note for billing: search for `promo_inactive` errors in the last 48h and flag partner campaign `gft-2026-03` for manual review.
maria_support: Closing thread for now — reopening if we see more incidents.
